positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description: Develop ETL data pipeline with AWS API-Gateway, Lambda, Batch and Kinesis. Write and deploy with Terraform.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Develop and maintain ETL applications written in Python. 
Utilize REST APIs, Mongodb, Docker, Salesforce, s3, dynamodb, Cloudformation and miscellaneous AWS services.
Apply PCI and Soc 2 policies to applications and processes.
Develop and maintain core internal libraries including unit and integration tests.
Manage source code with Git/Github. Review and approve changes in Github
Create, update and resolve issues in Jira

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Execute testing procedures and report defects in Jira
Create, update and resolve issues in Jira
Create and manage workflow configurations for an Apache Camel based application
Create and manage indexes in Elasticsearch
Develop backend data processing applications in Python 3.5
Develop scripts and queries for Mongodb
Deploy Python applications from Nexus to servers
Monitor for and report production issues in a daily briefing
Utilize linux console tools as needed - bash, ssh, grep, git, vim, etc

positions.title: Operations Support Specialist
positions.description: Monitor applications and troubleshoot issues remotely over ssh and AWS console. Develop scripts for data loading into Mongodb.
